pages.title: Lực Hấp Dẫn
pages.master_prompt: A multi-layer papercraft diorama in soft watercolor wash style, no text no numbers no labels. Deep indigo-to-violet night sky background made of torn watercolor paper, scattered tiny silver-foil star dots, wispy cotton-like paper clouds. Midground: three celestial bodies arranged on a diagonal axis for depth — a large radiant orange-yellow sun (upper corner, layered paper sunburst rays) — a blue-green Earth sphere at center with raised paper-cut continents — a small grey cratered moon (lower corner, positioned much closer to Earth than the sun). Two ribbon-like curved paper strokes represent gravitational pull: a thick bold ribbon connecting Moon-Earth, a thinner fainter ribbon connecting Sun-Earth. Foreground: ocean water rendered as two stacked paper layers — a flat pale-blue sea layer and a raised 3D paper bulge layer swelling toward the moon's direction, small quilled spiral paper waves around the bulge. Shadow-box depth with soft drop shadows between layers. Cinematic diorama lighting, pastel watercolor bleed edges, tactile paper texture, no flat illustration — physical layered paper craft look.

pages.title: Lực Ly Tâm
pages.master_prompt: Papercraft watercolor diorama, no text no numbers no labels. Dark navy-black space background with a faint translucent vellum ring suggesting orbital motion, swirling ink-wash motion streaks. Midground: Earth centered, axis tilted ~23 degrees shown as a thin paper rod through the poles, raised paper continents, a curved ribbon of paper wrapping the equator tapering to a point (no arrowhead) indicating spin direction, small moon anchor-point to one side. Foreground: two symmetric water bulges on opposite sides of Earth — far-side bulge and near-side bulge — built with foam-spacer layered shadow-box technique for natural cast shadows, emphasizing symmetry. Soft pastel watercolor textures, tactile layered paper, diorama lighting with visible depth gaps between layers.
